name: Dart+26-IRF
scope: Engineering survey and topographic mapping for railway applications.
area: Ireland - on or related to the DART+ rail project from Dublin city centre to Drogheda, Greystones, Hazelhatch and Kilcock.
remarks: Intermediate CRS created in 2026 to assist the emulation of the ETRS89 / Dart+26 SnakeGrid projected CRS through transformation ETRS89-IRE [ETRF2000] to Dart+26-IRF (1) (code 11462) used in conjunction with the Dart+26-TM map projection (code 11463).
